xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: This matter is filed in relation to CENVAT Credit availed on molasses and the same is pending before Hon’ble High Court, Allahabad as an appeal filed by the Department.

This matter was filed in relation to demand of excise duty on sale of electricity. The Department has dropped the said proceedings vide order dated 07.08.2025 and hence, this matter was closed. Subsequently, the department filed an appeal before the Commissioner (Appeals) against the order dated 07.08.2025, which was in our favour. Therefore, the case has now been re-opened and is pending for hearing.
